description: Apply a graphic style from the document's Graphic Styles panel to items. By default the style replaces their appearance; with merge it is added to it (Alt/Option-click in the panel)

merge.description: Add the style to the items' current appearance instead of replacing it. Default false

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: apply_graphic_style
title: Apply Graphic Style
